FIX-06: 數學語病與細節精準度問題：1) Chapter 2 寫「高樓層誘獲量竟比一樓高出 4 倍到近 17 倍【推算】」有倍數差 1 倍語病（46.9/11.8 = 3.97 倍、137.29/8.14 = 16.87 倍，應為「高達一樓的 4 倍到近 17 倍」而非「高出」）；2) 16 目（1.59 mm）與 55 目（0.46 mm）係中心網距（pitch），Chapter 3 寫「孔距」與 K152-0207 visual_rights 寫「孔徑」易與扣除線徑後之淨孔徑混淆；3) K152-0203 將 S06 機械撞擊引發虹彩炎／角膜炎擴大成「高劑量暴露」；4) K152-0204 未註記 S07 的 56% vs 16% 檢定值為臨界顯著 p < 0.055；5) K152-0214 與 Chapter 5 寫「剩餘約 5% 水溶性毒液裡那僅占 0.1% 的毒蛋白」易被誤讀為 5% 的 0.1%（實為占總毒液量約 0.1% w/w）；6) K152-0216／Chapter 6 寫「壓到水下 20 公分還會同步收縮鎖氣、絕不散架」略過 S20 原文「3–10 公分已有部分氣泡逸出、其餘氣泡於逾 20 公分仍留存」之細節。 → 逐一修正上述 6 處精準度措辭：Chapter 2 改「高達一樓的約 4 倍到近 17 倍【推算】」；網目換算統一標註「中心網距（尚未扣除線徑）」；S06 改強調外力撞擊眼部之機械傷害；S07 視需要註記 p < 0.055；S17/S18 改寫「占整體毒液量僅約 0.1% 的水溶性毒蛋白」；S20 改寫「下壓超過 20 公分仍能保留部分氣泡不散架」。

FIX-07: 部分編輯欄位與內文夾雜非台灣慣用流行語：K152-0212.editorial.payoff 含「智商稅」、「硬核指南」；K152-0206.editorial.payoff 含「拉滿」；K152-0215.editorial.payoff 含「爆表」；K152-0204.answer_target 含「遠遠輾壓」。另全案寫「膿泡」而台灣官方（S24）慣用「膿皰」。 → 將「智商稅／硬核／拉滿／爆表／輾壓」改為自然台灣繁中用語（如「冤枉錢／實用指南／極高／極強／大幅高於」），並確認「膿皰／膿泡」全案一致（建議採台灣醫學慣用之「膿皰」）。

changes: FIX-01: Hallucinated or mismatched paper titles, DOIs, publication dates, article/page numbers, and swapped E-numbers across 6 sources: S18 (PMC10056818 wrong title/date/article/DOI 10.3390/ijms24065620 -> actual 'The Integrity of the Blood–Brain Barrier as a Critical Factor for Regulating Glutamate Levels in Traumatic Brain Injury', 2023 Mar 20; 24(6):5897, DOI 10.3390/ijms24065897), S20 (PMC8484045 wrong title/date/pages -> actual 'Production of l-glutamate family amino acids in Corynebacterium glutamicum: Physiological mechanism, genetic modulation, and prospects', 2021 Sep 20; 6(4):302–325), S22 (PMC9407611 wrong title/date/article/DOI 10.3390/foods11162516 -> actual 'Effect of Monosodium Glutamate on Salt and Sugar Content Reduction in Cooked Foods for the Sensory Characteristics and Consumer Acceptability', 2022 Aug 19; 11(16):2512, DOI 10.3390/foods11162512), S23 (PMC2871322 wrong DOI 10.1249/JSR.0b013e31817f2321 -> actual 10.1249/JSR.0b013e31817f23fc), S02 (EFSA title swaps E 624 and E 625 -> E 624 is ammonium glutamate, E 625 is magnesium glutamate), and S05 (Health Canada title mismatches actual 'Monosodium glutamate (MSG) and other sources of glutamate in foods'). → Correct title, canonical_url (DOI), and publisher citation metadata on X152R3-S02, S05, S18, S20, S22, and S23 to match the verified primary pages verbatim.

FIX-02: Undisclosed IGTC / UIC / private-company ties and overstated independence claim: Geha et al. 2000 (S13) and Tarasoff & Kelly 1993 (S14) received financial support from the industry-funded International Glutamate Technical Committee (IGTC); Kurihara 2015 (S19) author formerly headed the Umami Information Center (UIC) and Table 1 cites UIC director Ninomiya (2014); Reeds et al. 2000 (S17) appeared in an IGTC-sponsored J Nutr symposium supplement (though the underlying experiment was publicly funded by NIH/USDA-ARS); Chung et al. 2022 (S22) co-first author works at private firm Kwang-Dong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (and Dankook Univ. is private), contradicting S22.summary's '五所公部門學研單位'. Consequently, theme.evidence_gaps (2)'s claim '全數改採聲明無利益衝突與無商業資助之獨立大學、醫院與公部門研究' is inaccurate. → Transparently disclose IGTC funding in S13.limitations and S14.limitations, UIC affiliation/data provenance in S19.limitations, IGTC symposium context (distinct from NIH/USDA-ARS experimental funding) in S17.limitations, correct S22.summary affiliation wording ('五所公部門學研單位' -> '韓國產學研團隊，含昌原國立大學、韓國食品研究院、檀國大學與製藥食品企業研發人員，研究未獲外部資助且聲明無利益衝突'), and rewrite theme.evidence_gaps (2) honestly.

FIX-03: Study-design factual error on S24 (PMC8030773): reading_scope and limitations describe Kanbay et al. 2018 as a '隨機交叉' (randomized crossover) trial, directly contradicting Section 4 (Limitations), which states 'the order in which the study was done was not randomized'. → Replace '隨機交叉' with '非隨機順序自身對照交叉試驗（固定四週順序，每週洗脫一週）' in X152R3-S24.reading_scope and X152R3-S24.limitations.

FIX-04: Abstract-vs-full-text provenance mismatch and missing animal-model disclosure on S17 / K152-0307 / Chapter 3: S17.read_via states only the PubMed abstract (PMID 10736365) was read, yet S17.limitations and K152-0307.notes claim '搭配人體代謝綜述印證' which does NOT appear in the abstract (only piglets are reported). FIX-08: In K152-0318.answer_target, the sodium warning for hypertension/heart/liver/kidney patients cites general daily sodium ceilings (<=2,400 mg TW / <2,000 mg WHO) without retaining TFDA's explicit '遵照醫囑' phrasing (individual clinical sodium caps may be stricter). → Add '並遵照醫囑控管個人限鈉額度' alongside the general <=2,400 mg / <2,000 mg benchmark in K152-0318.answer_target.
